title-ar.svg.source: FlightHopper typesetting of the Arabic title "الملكية الأردنية" in Aref Ruqaa Regular (public/fonts/ArefRuqaa-Regular.ttf), shaped with HarfBuzz and outlined in gold #d2aa63: glyphs widened 1.15x and thickened by a 40-unit stroke, the kaf and the nun drawn out along the baseline by 1550 and 600 font units, 1900 units extra word space. Not Royal Jordanian's artwork.

emblem.svg.source: FlightHopper typesetting of the word "عالية" (Alia) in Aref Ruqaa Regular (public/fonts/ArefRuqaa-Regular.ttf), shaped with HarfBuzz, glyphs narrowed to 0.62x into a compact block, gold #d2aa63 with a 12-unit stroke. It stands in for the calligraphic monogram beside door 1, which has no free file; it is not a copy of it.
